body: Boeing has confirmed it will miss its target of delivering about 500 737 MAX aircraft in 2026, because wing production cannot keep pace. The company delivered 367 737s in the first nine months of 2026, leaving 133 deliveries needed in the fourth quarter to reach the target, while the third-quarter average was just above 41 per month, below the roughly 44 per month required in the final quarter. Chief Executive Kelly Ortberg said on the company's earnings call that wing production remains the main constraint on 737 MAX output, noting that all 737 MAX wings are built at Renton and are among the first major parts assembled, so any slowdown there limits the whole production plan.

Boeing is holding at a rate of 47 737s per month until that rate is shown to be sustainable, after some flow improvements did not deliver the expected savings and additional capacity was added where improvements fell short. The plan to stabilise at 47 per month, originally expected before summer 2026, is now expected in early 2027, and the move to 52 per month has slipped from the first half of 2027 to the second half, with a longer-term ambition of 63 per month. Further growth depends heavily on Federal Aviation Administration production certification for a new North Line at Everett, Washington, which opened in July and is initially set to add five aircraft per month beyond Renton's 47, with the first MAX 10 rolling out on October 26. Despite the delay, deliveries are still ahead of last year: third-quarter deliveries were 124, compared with 121 a year earlier, and nine-month deliveries rose more than 10 percent, from 330 in 2025 to 367 in 2026, while final assembly rework has fallen 40 percent since early 2025.
en.summary: Boeing will miss its 2026 target of about 500 737 MAX deliveries because wing production at Renton remains the main constraint, pushing the 47-per-month stabilisation to early 2027 and the 52-per-month step to the second half of 2027.
en.title: Boeing admits it will miss 500-jet 737 MAX delivery target as wing output lags

body: 波音坦承將無法達成2026年交付約500架737MAX的目標，原因是機翼產能跟不上。2026年前九個月波音已交付367架737，若要達標，第四季還需再交付133架；第三季每月平均僅略高於41架，低於最後一季每月約44架的需求。執行長在財報電話會議上確認，機翼生產仍是737MAX生產最主要的限制因素；所有737MAX機翼都在Renton製造，且屬於最先組裝的主要部件之一，因此任何放緩都會限制整體生產計畫。波音表示，優先事項是先穩定生產，並建立可交付安全且高品質飛機的體系。

在部分改善措施未帶來預期效益後，波音已在相關環節增加產能，並將維持每月47架的速率，直到證明該速率可以持續。原本預計在2026年夏季前穩定在每月47架，現預計要到2027年初；每月52架的目標也從2027年上半年延後至下半年，長期目標則為每月63架。進一步增產高度取決於能否取得聯邦航空總署對位於Everett的新產線的生產認證；該設施於7月啟用，初期將在Renton每月47架之外再增加每月5架，首架MAX10已於10月26日下線。儘管目標落空，交付量仍較去年增加：第三季交付124架，略高於去年同期的121架；前九個月交付量由2025年的330架升至2026年的367架，增幅逾10%，而最終組裝的返工量自2025年初以來已減少40%。
zh.summary: 波音坦承將錯失2026年約500架737MAX的交機目標，Renton機翼產能仍是主要瓶頸；每月47架的穩定時程延至2027年初，每月52架延至2027年下半年。
